newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA - PENNU H1 TURNOVER DOUBLES.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA - PENNU H1 TURNOVER DOUBLES.

text.p: Pennu computer producer said on Friday that its first-half turnover was 84.5 million kroons versus 40.3 million kroons in the same period last year.
Its exports were 14.1 million kroons in the first six months, compared to 0.5 million kroons in the same period last year, it added in a statement.
Its roduction and sales rose by four times compared with the same period last year.
PCT Liising, its leasing subsidiary, had a turnover of 23 million kroons.
Pennu will announce its consolidated and audited results at the end of August.
